_doc: PROPOSAL (task M3-01), not game data. Regrowth stages and tending (spec section 5). Stage numbers: 0 polluted, 1 clean, 2 planted, 3 growing, 4 sustained, 5 thriving. unlock: the id that opens planting and watering. seeds: the third currency, for planting only: kit = seeds the found kit holds, per_hex = seeds to plant one hex, from_stage = seeds a hex gives back on reaching each stage (plants that bloom). plant_s_per_hex: bot seconds of hand planting to take one clean hex to planted (a few patch actions). water_s and water_hexes: one watering action and the hexes it covers. burst_pts: growth points a watering adds at once. wet_s: seconds a watered hex then grows at full rate (1 point a second, real time); dry_rate: the rate when not watered. rewater_s: seconds before the same hex can take another burst. points_to_leave: growth points a hex needs to leave stages 2, 3 and 4 (index = stage). stage_reward: cubes and field data paid per hex on reaching stages 2 to 5, cubes times the district's hex_work over districts.json stage_reward_ref_work. district_stage_reward: paid once when the district itself reaches stages 1 to 5 (cubes times the same multiplier).
